events.title: Quick Playtest Recap + Demo Coming up Next
events.summary: Hey fellow Rogues, Thank you for joining us during the playtest! What a crazy past couple of weeks! A few of us at the studio (well, maybe just me) kept waking up at 4AM for a week or so because it was just so exciting to see players enjoying the game, getting feedback, and putting ourselves out there a bit. We wanted to give a quick update on how the playtest went, now that things have settled down a little and Labor Day weekend is here. Hope everyone enjoys some great weather and time with fam

events.title: Deadzone Rogue 2 Playtest is Closed - Thank You!
events.summary: Fellow Rogues, the Playtest is officially closed! A huge THANK YOU to everyone who jumped in and played! If you have any feedback from the playtest, we'd love to hear it to keep improving. Definitely let us know what you think in this short survey, or via #playtest-feedback in the Discord, or on Reddit. events.title: Bug Fixes based on Feedback
events.summary: DZ2 Playtest Patch Notes - 0.1.0.1 Fixes Performance improvements to fix several crashes. Fixed an issue where checkpoints would not load the player’s build when returning to mission. Fixed an issue where the Defense and Offense categories were swapped in the Imprint Codex. Fixed several items’ SFX that were playing incorrectly on other players. Augments Added new icons for the Heresy Augment. Adjusted wording on the Heresy Augment to make it more clear. Changed Heresy Augment to build up faster
